name: Tomodachi no Mama to, ~Hirusagari no Eroero Kozukuri Lesson
original_name: 友達のママと、～昼下がりのエロエロ子作りレッスン
source:
This story is about Keigo, a boy whose class thinks of as 'the cute boy.' But for as long as Keigo can remember he's had a crush on his best friend Yukito's mother, Aya. One day Keigo comes to play at Yukito's house and suddenly gets a lot closer to Aya. "Keigo-kun, I'll teach you everything. E-V-E-R-Y-thing."

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038641.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
辻圭吾是班里公认的“可爱男孩”。然而从记事起，他便一直暗恋好友东野行人的母亲东野绫。某天，圭吾到行人家里玩，突然与绫亲近了许多。

“圭吾，我会把一切都教给你。所—有—的—一—切。”

[根据 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038641.html]DLsite English[/url]修改]
